with_issues.note: moderation /unassign route (gh-issue-3163, merged 10-26). PR correctly adds the missing backend route (closing the dead-client-path gap flagged in #3163), the ComplianceRepository::unassign_moderation_case mutation is org-scoped via organization_id=$2 (no IDOR), reverts under_review->pending only, and ships a role-gate 403 regression test + a happy-path test that asserts assignee cleared + status reverted against the DB. ModerationCaseResponse is Serialize-only snake_case (no rename_all), so the test's json["assigned_to_name"]/json["id"] snake_case accessors are correct — no camelCase JSON-key-case mismatch. BUT: (1) correctness/medium — repo uses fetch_one, so an unknown or cross-org case id yields SqlxError::RowNotFound which the handler maps to 500 for ALL errors; a routine not-found should be 404. PR explicitly perpetuates this from assign_moderation_case, so both handlers share the wart. (2) authz/low — any org moderator/manager can unassign a case assigned to a different moderator (only require_moderator_role + org scope, no ownership check); confirm intent. Filed #3174 proposing RowNotFound->404 mapping in both assign+unassign + a 404 test, and an authz intent check.
